title: Partner Session Receipt
description: Machine-readable form of the [Partner session receipt] text block. Field names and allowed values match SKILL.md. receipt_schema_version 2 adds host/scope/config_source/roles_used for dual-host role tracking; a receipt without them is a v1 receipt and fails validation as the upgrade signal.

claude_session.description: Claude Code session id, or the literal string 'none'.

checks.description: Commands run, or an explicit statement that none were run.

anomalies.description: 'none' or a short description: permission wait, idle, empty review, failed check, other.

monitoring_level.description: Result of scripts/check-claude-cli.sh for this run.

direction.description: Which Partner flow ran: Codex orchestrating (A) or Claude delegating to Codex (B).

codex_jobs.description: Number of delegate-codex.sh background jobs, including fix rounds. 0 when none were used.

host.description: The runtime that loaded SKILL.md for this run (self-identified, not the .install-meta tiebreaker).

scope.description: Configuration scope in effect, or n/a when no configured role was touched.

config_source.description: Highest-priority layer that supplied the resolved config, per docs/config-schema.md; n/a when no configured role was touched.

roles_used.description: 'none', or a JSON array of every role invoked this run: {role, host, model, effort, verified}. An unverified role is still listed, never omitted.

receipt_schema_version.description: Always 2 for this contract; a receipt missing this field predates dual-host role tracking.
